stories.text: 🧟 LINEUP ALERT: Kyle Tucker is starting Rashee Rice (OUT). Kickoff's Sunday 4:25 PM — plenty of time to fix it. Or don't. We'll be watching.
⚡ Early edge: 49er Faith-Fool went from 19% to 45% against Claremont In Yo Stace!, led by Dobbins (13.60 pts).
😅 TDsMaGee is sweating out a close one with Mr. Action Jackson (42% to win). Starting RJ Harvey (14.60 pts) over Emanuel Wilson (5.20 pts) would have helped.
🗑️ DROP REGRET: Drake Maye averaged 7.5 before 49er Faith-Fool cut him in Week 4. Since: 33.3 a week. Now he's helping Brock You Like a Hurricane.
🏟️ Game to watch: DAL @ GB (Sunday 8:20 PM), 11 league starters in action with 161.63 pts up for grabs. It could swing Ramosverse vs Kirbo Crushers by 27%.
📺 Up next, Sunday 9:30 AM (HOU VS JAX): 9 league starters in action. Most riding on it: Ramosverse vs Kirbo Crushers (35.60 pts projected).
🗓️ Sunday's key matchup: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy 50% vs Ruffing the Passer. Watch Young (18.52 pts) vs Love (21.42 pts).
🕰️ Coulda-shoulda swap: If TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace! had swapped Wilson for Skattebo and Andrews back in Week 1, both would be ahead (+2 wins each).
🔭 Player to watch: Parker Washington (HOU VS JAX). ESPN projects 15.07 pts, and Ramosverse is 39% against Kirbo Crushers.
🤔 What could have been: If TDsMaGee and Kirbo Crushers had swapped RJ Harvey for Dallas Goedert back in Week 1, both would be ahead (+1 and +3 wins).
👀 League gossip: Kyle Tucker has 37.40 pts to play with against Gibb it to Me Baby.
📈 Stock rising: Brock You Like a Hurricane has its ESPN projection trending up.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 16% against The Mahomies — and won.
